source: Xendit Pricing Proposal for Fincom/MallPlus, signed 2026-06-24 by Patricio Soyao Jr. (CEO). Preferential rates, VAT-inclusive. Confirmed 2026-10-04: term sheet is NOT expired — rates kept as-is, open-ended (end=null).
notes: MDR here = the gateway's merchant discount rate charged to Fincom (PLATFORM COST). It is separate from seller fees (commission / service / txn fee charged to sellers).
Formula: max(rate_pct x amount, min_fee) + fixed_fee + processing_fee. All VAT-inclusive.
provider/method strings use the Same labels shown in Order Recon (Provider / Method columns).
MDR is only incurred on captured funds: when gate_on_capture=true, non-captured rows (failed/canceled/never-paid) return PHP 0 instead of blank. Set false to show ever-non-captured as blank.
GCash-direct rail (pp_gcashmp_glife + pp_gcash_webpay — same rail) = 2.5% VAT-inc, no fixed/proc (applied 2026-10-04).

rules.note: Domestic cards (Visa/MC/JCB). Intl 4.5%+PHP10 not distinguishable from recon data. PHP900/chargeback not in per-txn MDR.
QRPH: max(1%, PHP12). Channel not currently observed in recon.
BPI/UBP/RCBC: max(1.3%, PHP15). Channel not currently observed in recon.
GrabPay via Xendit. Not currently observed.
ShopeePay via Xendit. Not currently observed.
GCash rail (pp_gcashmp_glife + pp_gcash_webpay — mini-program and webpay are one and the same). MDR = 2.5% VAT-inclusive, no fixed/processing component (Shaun, 2026-10-04).
